binding_recovery_record.lifetime: committed only across interrupted database binding; validated and deleted before work/provider authority; absent after normal binding
binding_recovery_record.provenance: database resource identity and existing SQLite header only; no path, provider, query, credential, or user value

observation_integrity_digest.scope: private observation_id only; forbidden from every runtime and retained evidence channel

identifier_scope: edition_id and book_id are permitted only in private matched persistence and the direct matched report; logs, audit, traces, metrics, exports, support reports, and review evidence forbid them
integrity_and_recovery_scope: the content digest and binding recovery row are closed private persistence exceptions only; normal cleanup removes the recovery row
provider_title_scope: bounded exact provider response title is private durable comparison input only and is never reported, logged, audited, traced, metered, exported, or retained in review evidence
reuse: a validated current matched observation supplies edition_id/book_id and recomputes equal/different against the transient local title without provider refetch
